$comment: Single source of truth for the Toggle API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: A button that stays pressed until you press it again.
thumb: BIU

pressed / defaultPressed.description: On or off (controlled or not). Use onPressedChange to hear about changes.

examples.title: Icon toggles
examples.description: Square toggles for a toolbar. Icon-only toggles need an aria-label. In HTML, add data-vin-toggle and include vinui.js.

examples.title: Outline, with text
examples.description: A border and a text label, for toggles that stand alone.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Small, medium and large, matching the Button heights.

a11y: A <button> with aria-pressed: screen readers say "pressed" or "not pressed".
Keep the label the same when pressed ("Bold", not "Unbold"); aria-pressed tells the state.
The pressed state is shown by a filled background, not only by colour of the text.
